question: genre
text: Which genre has the longest tracks on average?
answer: The genre with the longest tracks on average is "Sci Fi & Fantasy" with an average length of approximately 2,911,783 milliseconds.

args.sql: SELECT Genre.Name, AVG(Track.Milliseconds) AS AvgLength FROM Track JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId GROUP BY Genre.Name ORDER BY AvgLength DESC LIMIT 1;
